resources.string: Codex subscription login

Third-party, unofficial sideload experiment. Login reuses the Codex CLI OAuth identity; OpenAI has not publicly authorized Helix to use it. Credentials stay in this Runtime UID. Continuing may risk the account or service continuity.

Claude subscription login

Third-party, unofficial personal sideload experiment. Anthropic has not publicly authorized this OAuth identity or consumer subscription interface for Helix. Credentials stay in the Runtime UID. Claude Free can test the login entry, but authorization may require upgrading to Pro/Max and does not establish Claude Code entitlement.

Grok subscription login
